newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines eyes Yankee bond issue by Q1 this year.
newsitem.headline: Philippines eyes Yankee bond issue by Q1 this year.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank is considering a Yankee bond issue by the first quarter of this year, Central Bank governor Gabriel Singson said on Wednesday.
Singson told reporters that 10 investment banks have proposed to underwrite the bond which will have at least 30 year maturity.
"There were other proposals to issue longer bonds such as 50 to 100 years," he added. Singson declined to say how much will be raised from the bond flotation.

Among those which have offered to underwrite the Yankee bond are JP Morgan, Citicorp, Morgan Stanley, ING Baring, CS First Boston, Goldman Sachs, Lehman Brothers, Salomon Brothers, Bankers' Trust and Merill Lynch.
The Philippine government has so far issued dollar bonds in the Euromarket and yen-denominated bonds in the Japanese market.
